scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "wait-on -d 300 tcp:127.0.0.1:3001 && npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n server,web,voice -c blue,magenta,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "wait-on -d 300 tcp:127.0.0.1:3001 && npm --prefix web run dev" "wait-on -d 300 tcp:127.0.0.1:3001 && node scripts/voice.mjs"
